answer: This document is a Quality Assurance Report Certification issued by Experimental Pathology Laboratories, Inc. (EPL) for a study conducted by Borriston Laboratories (study #1419A). It certifies that EPL's Quality Assurance Unit reviewed all parts of the pathology phase of a study titled 'Bioassay of Cigarette Smoke Condensates for Potential Tumorigenic Activity on Mouse Skin' (a revised pathology report). The review was conducted from March 2 to June 8, 1983, and all findings were reported to the Study Director (Dr. William O. Iverson) and Management. The certification is signed by Janet Milazzo on June 8, 1983.
